scope: Pinned SDK std/hexdump/postfix with local native wall-clock prefix and ASCII classifier; formatting call order/arguments, auto-flush restoration, all256 hex byte values and color codes
limitations: Printf/flush execute only in actual_printf mode, yielding byte-sink proof there. Calendar executes only in actual_calendar mode with a fixed timestamp-getter fixture; color lookup is actual only in actual_modules mode. No real-clock or physical-output proof.
Valid severity0..5 for call fixtures; byte-sink mode excludes severity0 prefixes because their null label is not a valid string. Bounded arguments/data and canonical bool states only.
Locale-specific printability is unproven; native ASCII classification is exercised through hexdump. Whole-image startup/linking and byte identity remain gates.
